name: com.foreverworks/bitwarden
title: Bitwarden
description: MCP server for a Bitwarden vault, through the official CLI

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_CLIENT_ID_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding the account's API key client id.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding the API key's client secret.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_MASTER_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding the master password that unlocks the vault.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: A self-hosted or EU server, e.g. https://vault.bitwarden.eu. Leave empty for bitwarden.com.
